historical_seed_collision_check: REQUIRED_BEFORE_COLLECTION_AGAINST_ALL_HISTORY; stop on collision without outcome-based replacement
family_substitution: PROHIBITED; retain a failed nominated family
condition: Nominal cached native prefix and natural reset distribution; no fault/task shopping
sensor_menu: Seven arm-joint qpos/qvel, FK TCP xyz and20Hz clock only
discovery_encoding: ONE binary split of ONE of the five frozen response bins; integer threshold candidates0..20. Maximize mean discovery Gini reduction for the root pose-cell label across both probes; lexicographic ties. Common frozen split for all methods before calibration; an uninformative split is a valid null.
common_deadline: Native hold pads after the70-control macro, or after STOP, to90 controls. Record macro-end and common-deadline native success. Never impute STOP or missing outcomes.
same_objective_control: Independent full-model strong/POMDP control with identical state, sensors, actions, horizon and worst-cost objective. Share identical executions; no new algorithmic gain is expected.
same_information: Identical discovery model, sensor/probe menu and calibration budget; evaluator oracle rows isolated. Static transition ignoring violates the model-based guarantee. It may receive the same independent empirical terminal gate, accurately labelled as such.
atomic_stop: Close/seal the current native episode and parent at a ceiling. Keep incomplete counts without replacement.

calibration.source: New independent parents, frozen policy-induced terminal-history population; no DSRE interval transfer
calibration.gate: LowerCP>=.90 in the WHOLE selected terminal stratum. Failure withholds/STOPs; no upstream replanning or policy refit on calibration outcomes.
calibration.scope: Conditional success of that fixed source/population/macro-with-padding; not universal G, path safety or complete physical dynamics. The current exact planner has no stochastic extension.
calibration.missingness: A post-qualification missing endpoint blocks unconditional complete-case CP claims without a justified censoring model; preserve missing labels and worst-case completion bounds.

H1.statement: A discovery-frozen more-disambiguating probe can destroy the fixed-macro recovery option
H1.measurement: Sixteen evaluator-only ROOT object-minus-TCP xy pose cells with cuts-.03,0,.03m. Condition the discovery-only Laplace-one decoder on the SAME root proprioceptive signature and then augment with each probe response. Quantize root qpos at.01rad, qvel at.1rad/s and TCP at.005m; unseen signatures use the discovery prior. Compare augmented decoders on untouched parents and report the root-only decoder. This is a conditional information PROXY, not Shannon mutual information or evidence about already-visible facts.
H1.probe_order: Discovery decoder accuracy, then probe ID; freeze before calibration/test. Retain a tie.
H1.support_criterion: Corrected lower bound on held-out decoder-accuracy difference>.05 AND lowerCP(prevalence K_low_nonempty/K_high_empty)>.05 on128 hash-fixed oracle parents. No favorable probe replacement.
H1.K: Macros with actually recorded native success from the actual post-probe state at the same deadline

H2.statement: At90 native controls, qualified viability-aware probing improves completion over filtered entropy by>.05
H2.test: Conservative paired bound L_CP(RPD_only_success)-U_CP(entropy_only_success); split endpoint alpha across both marginal tails
H2.full_model_control: Expected equality; differences require an interface/model/tie-break audit, not a solver novelty claim

H3.statement: Finite policy/obstruction classifications remain source-grounded in the fixed held-out oracle subset
H3.test: Every physical witness has actual source rows; upperCP(model/source mismatch)<=.05 on128 oracle parents
H3.scope: No-policy is horizon/menu conditional. Missing or unknown rows do not establish physical impossibility; zero observed mismatches is not an all-state guarantee.

hypothesis_alpha.accounting: Two H1 endpoints, one H2 and one H3, per family; paired-difference bounds split their endpoint alpha further across two tails

pilot_guards: Exact nominated source versions,20Hz,200-control episode limit, fixed prefix65/53; already-successful prefixes counted separately and never replaced
Complete continuous traces and controller-memory lineage; no within-history reset, state injection or rewind
Repeat parity: position<=1e-5m, orientation/qpos<=1e-4rad, velocity/observation<=1e-4,time<=1e-9s, exact contacts and task flags
All native channels finite and all ten probe frames present; missing observations stop, never become false
Verify nonzero native actuator/TCP effect against neutral hold. No positive task effect or favorable action diversity is required for qualification
Object motion/contact change remains evaluator-only; force, damage and continuous-time safety are unmeasured
A failed source/coupling guard blocks that family, without repair/task substitution in the registered study
negative_interpretations: Passive or uninformative probes: no demonstrated physical tradeoff
Motion but no option loss: H1 unestablished
No qualified terminal leaves: insufficient support, not invented success
Both macros fail: fixed repertoire boundary, no new skill
Model/source mismatch: narrow scope, not physical impossibility
